# Stage 2K fixtures — SYNTHETIC — NOT REAL COST DATA

Produced by the **Stage 2K** code (commit `f196a1d`) and kept unchanged, so that later stages can prove
they still read older data:

- `SYNTHETIC_DRAFTS.xlsx` — the synthetic BQ used by the draft-row tests (artificial descriptions, dummy figures).
- `SYNTHETIC_DRAFTS.review-backup.json` — a review backup with project details, every verified proposal
  approved, and Stage 2K row decisions: placeholders confirmed as not stated, the negative row excluded,
  every other draft row approved. It has no export record, because Stage 2K could not export.

Do not edit these files: they stand for data users already have.
